definitions.explanation: Managed or operated by the government, as opposed to private enterprise.

examples.japanese: {官営|かんえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I worked at a government-run factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{官営|かんえい}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}→設立：14171_setsuritsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many state-run enterprises were established during the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: {富岡|とみおか}{製糸場|せいしじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧{官営|かんえい}⟦{模範|もはん}→模範：19610_mohan⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: The Tomioka Silk Mill is known as a government-operated model factory established by the Meiji government.

notes:
A compound of {官|かん} (government, official) and {営|えい} (to operate, manage). Describes enterprises, facilities, or services operated directly by the government.

Historically significant in Japanese history: during the Meiji era, the government established numerous {官営|かんえい} factories and enterprises to modernize Japan's industry. Many were later sold off to private companies in a policy known as {払|はら}い{下|さ}げ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官営|かんえい}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: government-operated factory
- {官営|かんえい}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: state-run enterprise
- {官営|かんえい}⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧: government-operated railway
- {官営|かんえい}⟦{模範|もはん}→模範：19610_mohan⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: government model factory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国営|こくえい}: nationally operated — specifically run by the national government
- ⟦{公営|こうえい}→公営：22485_kouei⟧: publicly operated — run by any public entity including local governments
- {民営|みんえい}: privately operated — the opposite of government-run
